submittedPrompt: 绘制清晰中文网页局部组件对照板，白底浅灰面、细边框小圆角、字体紧凑，独立场景用留白细线分开。只画指定局部，不画外部主人导航、浏览器或审查文字。七个紧凑局部行，实际Git状态装饰只能是文件名旁8px左右的小圆点，不得画M/D/U等字母或状态徽章。1 一段真实目录树：00-Inbox展开，子笔记“示例笔记.md”蓝色浅底选中、文件图标、右侧更多…处于激活；30-Knowledge收起，两个目录均有展开箭头和文件夹图标。树右侧竖向宽度调整手柄有键盘焦点描边。2 一条文件“冲突.md”旁深红圆点#ad0707。3 文件“删除.md”旁同深红圆点。4 文件“修改.md”旁棕色圆点#895503。5 文件“重命名.md”旁紫色圆点#6c6cc4。6 两条文件“新增.md”旁绿色圆点#587c0c，“其他变更.md”旁灰色圆点#646464。7 文件夹“示例目录”展开，父目录旁红色圆点，子项“冲突稿.md”红点、“修改稿.md”棕点、“干净稿.md”没有任何状态圆点。只有真实树行/箭头/更多/调整手柄，无创建/删除/提交/其他工具栏或解释文字。

sourceContracts.title: Notebook tree expansion, selection and desktop resize

entry.trigger: Browse notebook tree or drag separator

permissionRules: Authenticated owner browser session; /api owner hook returns 401 if absent and 503 during maintenance. Mutations require configured Origin and CSRF token (apps/server/app.ts:141). No administrator/member role split is implemented for these owner surfaces.
Git marker exists only when plugin contribution is registered/visible through PluginSlot and component mounted; marker is informational, introduces no new write action.

importantStates: Mounted Git fileDecoration: conflict DD/AU/UD/UA/DU/AA/UU red priority5; removed D red priority4; modified M/T brown priority3; rename/copy R/C purple priority2; untracked?? or stagedA green priority1; generic change gray priority0
Folder Git marker aggregates highest-priority descendant; clean entry has no marker; title/role=img/aria-label describe state

responsive.behavior: Sidebar resize is desktop surface; <=720px sidebar becomes fixed drawermin(290px,85vw). Desktop rail60px and sidebar variable width; exact target captures unverified.

sourceContracts.designReason: Existing user-visible surface requires baseline-aligned hierarchy, controls, feedback and responsive treatment without adding behavior.
notes: Source inventory only; no runtime behavior asserted.
Canonical tree-host Git decoration coverage is included under WS-103; settings Git management surfaces reference the same widget/state, without a separate new platform feature.

postprocessing: Original built-in PNG copied byte-for-byte; no pixel edits.
